page: Microsoft Azure DC8es_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEV5 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached volumes. It is compatible with Premium Storage options to support disk-bound workloads. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio position this instance as a stable resource for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of local storage maintenance. The hardware profile is configured for general-purpose applications, database hosting utilizing remote storage, and moderate memory-use enterprise workloads.
